## Description

Describe the observed behavior and its impact.

## Reproduction

List the smallest reliable steps, inputs, and environment details. Remove secrets and personal data.

## Expected behavior

Describe what should have happened.

## Additional context

Include relevant logs or screenshots after checking that they contain no sensitive information.
